title: Power Up Your Powder Room! - Get The Look 4
bodyHtml:
Hello Bathroom Enthusiast,

Just because it’s the smallest space in your home doesn’t mean it deserves any less attention when it comes to design. In this month’s get the look article, we’ll explore how to power up your powder room by making the most out of the space you have while injecting big style vibes at the same time!

Powder Rooms and small bathroom spaces are perfect for letting your design spirit run wild, allowing you to experiment with opposing colours and textures because they are often a stand-alone area, meaning you don’t need to worry about clashes with other rooms in your house. 

When thinking about your powder room, the top consideration is of course space. However, even though your floor-plan is tiny, using the right combination and configuration of bathroom fixtures and products can make a huge difference in both functionality and space perception. 

Injecting Colour!

White bevelled subway tiles and fresh painted walls does wonders for this powder room’s space perception - the light entering through the window saturates the space making it appear much larger than it actually is, further amplified by the wall mounted mirror, with it’s matte white solid surface edges matching well with the tile texture.

Introducing coloured product to a clean base like this is a great way to not just make a statement design wise, but brings focus to the fixtures in a unique way too.

We have installed our Spy 75 in gorgeous contemporary Matte Indigo, a tactile finish that feels as great as it looks! The Matte Black wall-hung toilet sits in beautiful contrast to it’s surroundings with a matching matte black flush button, and the brushed nickel bathroom accessories add a nice metallic finishing touch to the whole aesthetic.

Choosing the Perfect Basin

A wall mounted basin like our Spy 75 works great in small spaces thanks to its short projection of a mere 270mm, giving it just the right amount of depth for function, but conservative enough with space at the same time.

Wall mounting your basin removes the need for a vanity, saving you even more space, and because the Spy 75 has it’s own built-in shelf, mounting essentials like hand soap and aesthetic details is achieved with ease.

Pair with a short projection Wall Hung Toilet

Choosing a wall-hung toilet provides 2 huge benefits - the cistern and internal workings of the toilet are hidden inside the wall saving you an easy 150mm in space, and the added bonus of a short projection toilet like our Tutto Evo saves you even more space! 

Wall-hung setups like this are perfect for the contemporary bathroom, but do require a particular amount of wall thickness to make the installation possible and are often a little more expensive to install, so make sure you consult with your plumber first to find out if this works in your particular setup.
